description: A month grid in one calendar with the day numbers of a second calendar beside them; Gregorian beside Hijri, Ethiopic or Persian (I18N-003).

props.name: firstDate
props.description: The earliest date that can be chosen; the start of 1900 when absent.

props.name: lastDate
props.description: The latest date that can be chosen; the end of 2100 when absent.

props.name: calendar
props.description: The calendar of the grid; the app's `localisation.calendar` when absent.

props.name: secondaryCalendar
props.description: The calendar of the small day numbers; the app's `localisation.secondaryCalendar` when absent, and none if that is absent too.
